title: Outgoing events
intro: Connect your system to workspace activity. Destinations start paused until you approve sharing.
policy: Only record IDs and status metadata are sent. Message text, customer names, phone numbers, payment descriptions and signing secrets are excluded. Failures retry for up to 24 hours; three days without a success after failure disables delivery and queues an admin email.
name: Destination name
urlHelp: Use a public HTTPS address on port 443 without embedded credentials or a fragment. Redirects and private networks are blocked. Create a new destination to change its URL or subscriptions.
loadError: Could not load destinations. Use Refresh destinations to retry.
actionError: Could not save this change. Check the HTTPS address, destination limit and duplicate URLs. Refresh before creating again; the destination may already exist.
secretHelp: This secret appears once. Copy it into your receiving server's secret settings. Configure signature verification before enabling delivery. To replace a lost secret, delete this destination and create it again.
disabled: Disabled after three days of failures
failure: Delivery needs attention. Review the response code and your receiving server.
consent: I approve sending these record IDs and status metadata to this destination.
deletePrompt: Delete this destination, its secret and delivery history? In-flight requests may still finish.
historyHelp: Last 30 days. Request bodies contain metadata only. Response bodies and signature headers are not retained. Resends preserve the event ID.
noHistory: No deliveries yet. New subscribed events will appear after delivery is enabled.
historyError: Could not load or resend a delivery. Refresh delivery history to retry.
resendPrompt: Resend this event? The receiver must deduplicate by event ID. This queues another delivery attempt with a fresh signature.
signatureHelp: Verify HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot, and the exact raw request body using the signing secret. Compare signatures in constant time and reject timestamps older than five minutes.
deliveryHelp: Accept any valid event ID once, return a 2xx status promptly, and process work asynchronously. Requests time out after 10 seconds. Retry-After is honored for retryable failures. A pause cancels queued work; in-flight requests may finish.

failures.unsafe_destination: Destination no longer resolves only to public HTTPS addresses.
failures.receiver_unavailable: Could not reach the receiving server.
failures.receiver_rejected: The receiving server returned an unsuccessful response.
failures.redirect_rejected: The destination redirected. Register its final HTTPS URL.
failures.delivery_unavailable: Delivery or signing is temporarily unavailable.
failures.workspace_rate_limit: Waiting for the workspace delivery quota.
failures.quota_unavailable: Quota service is unavailable; delivery is waiting.
failures.endpoint_disabled: Destination was disabled after continuous failures.
